<P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;color:#000000'><B>PART III &#8212;&nbsp;NARRATIVE</B></P>
<P style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;color:#000000'>State below in reasonable detail why Forms 10-K, 20-F, 11-K, 10-Q, 10-D, N-CEN, N-CSR, or the transition report or portion thereof, could not be filed within the prescribed time period. (Attach extra Sheets if Needed)</P>
<P style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#000000'>State below in reasonable detail the reasons why Forms 10-K, 20-F, 11-K, 10-Q, N-SAR, or the transition report or portion thereof, could not be filed within the prescribed time period.</P>
<P style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#000000'>&#160;</P>
<P style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;color:#000000'>The Company did not complete its financial statements for the period ended July 31, 2025, the company was seeking new auding relationship, and on February 27, 2026  FRUCI &amp; ASSOCIATES II, PLLC was dismissed as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm, and the Board of Directors approved the appointment of PG Accountants LLC (&quot;PG&quot;) as the Company's new independent registered public accounting firm on the same date. </P>
